@graph.name: Trove
@graph.description: Trove is a free, local-first photo and video organizer for Windows and macOS. It never uploads, copies, or moves files: it organizes links back to them, exactly where they already live on disk.
featureList: Automatic organization by trip, person, camera, and location
Guided Sort for clearing large unsorted photo backlogs
Automatic duplicate photo and video detection
Automatic linking of edited photos back to their original
On-device AI photo search by content (CLIP model)
Zero-copy: never duplicates or moves original files
No cloud upload, no subscription, no account required

mainEntity.name: What is the best photo organizer for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a free, local photo organizer that doesn't require a cloud account, Trove reads your existing photo library and automatically groups everything into Trips, People, Cameras, and Location, without moving or re-importing a single file. It runs on Windows 10 and 11, and on macOS (Apple Silicon).

mainEntity.name: What is the best way to store and organize my photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep original files exactly where they are and layer organization on top, rather than importing everything into a new managed library. Trove is zero-copy: it never duplicates or moves files, it only creates organized links back to them, keeping originals portable and independent of any one app.

mainEntity.name: How do I sort thousands of unsorted photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trove's Guided Sort walks an unsorted backlog one cluster at a time, grouped by trip, date, person, camera, or location, asking a single question per cluster instead of per photo.

mainEntity.name: How do I find duplicate photos automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trove's Find Duplicates scans an entire library for visual duplicates, not just identical files, comparing a structural fingerprint and color profile of every photo. Matches are shown side by side for manual confirmation, and nothing is deleted automatically.

mainEntity.name: Is there a photo organizer that doesn't upload anything to the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trove never uploads, copies, or moves files anywhere. Everything, including its on-device AI photo search, runs locally with no cloud, no subscription, and no account required.
